key_value_encoding.size: 4 bytes, big-endian, written as "0xTTAABBCC" strings in the app

byte0_type.0x00: keyboard: byte1 = HID modifier bitmask, byte2/byte3 = HID keyboard usage(s) (single key uses byte3; combos may use byte2 and/or byte3)
byte0_type.0x02: consumer control, bytes2-3 = 16-bit HID Consumer usage
byte0_type.0x03: macro reference (never stored as a 32-bit value; see macro_binding)
byte0_type.0x05: mouse DPI (mouse devices only; hidden for keyboards)
byte0_type.0x07: system/OS mode (0x0700000e Win mode, 0x0700000f Mac mode)

mode_values.2: "button" – UI label "repeat": run until another key is pressed
mode_values.4: "repeat" – UI label "button": run while held, stop on release

macro_binding.note: UI labels for "button"/"repeat" are swapped relative to value names (chunk-DOvWlFxe.js:2188-2192). macro_index = index of macro in the uploaded macro table. Max 150 events per macro (chunk-DOvWlFxe.js:2349).
